title: Multi-omics Molecular Alterations of Tolerance and Response to Simulated Progressive Hemorrhage in Healthy Adult Humans
description: One hundred and thirty-three healthy adult human subjects recruited from two sites underwent an experimental model that simulate progressive central hypovolemia, lower body negative pressure (LBNP). The first cohort (n = 46) was recruited from U.S. Army Institute of Surgical Research in San Antonio, TX. The second cohort (n = 87) was recruited from the Human Physiology Laboratory at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN. Blood samples were collected before and after the LBNP procedure for multi-omics processing. Bioinformatic analysis will be performed to identify molecular profiles associated with response and tolerance to simulated progressive blood loss.
